title: The splicing rules of the ClinGen expert panels’ specifications applied to this study’s data: band likelihood ratios and tiers, and BP7 as each specification defines it.
description: The splicing rules of the expert panels' specifications applied to this study's data: band likelihood ratios and tiers, and BP7 as each defines it.
notes: Specifications: *BRCA1* and *BRCA2*, ENIGMA (GN092 and GN097, version 1.2) [39, 40]; *PALB2*, Hereditary Breast, Ovarian and Pancreatic Cancer panel (GN077, version 1.3) [41]; *VHL* (GN078, version 1.1) [42]. *BAP1*, *BARD1* and *RAD51C* have no current approved specification. | Every rule is applied to SpliceAI on the published basis (version 1.3.1, distance 4,999, unmasked, the largest of the four delta scores). The ENIGMA appendix gives a maximum distance of 10,000, which neither SpliceAI column of this study has, so the rule’s cut point is applied to the column as it stands. | BP7 follows each specification: ENIGMA, donor +7 and beyond and acceptor −21 and beyond, with BP4; *PALB2*, donor +8 and beyond and acceptor −22 and beyond, with and without BP4; *VHL* states no position, so this study’s distance bands are used, with SpliceAI at or below 0.1 and phyloP at or below 0.2. Not evaluated: VarSeak for *VHL*, and RNA evidence and PVS1 for *PALB2*. | Intervals come from resampling within each class of the gene (2,000 draws), and tiers are given at the point estimate and at the conservative end of the interval. The labels are this study’s assay labels, and the *VHL* panel’s concern about using the *VHL* SGE data as functional evidence is not evaluated here. No specification is taken as the truth for this study’s thresholds, and no threshold is changed.
